scoring_contract.note: Scores are initial design hypotheses, not measured truth. Re-score only from versioned evidence.

ideas.title: Evidence Graph and Claim-to-Code Traceability
ideas.hypothesis: Every material capability claim can be traced through registry entry, implementation path, test, runtime observation where applicable, and independent verifier.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Select 10 high-value claims and manually map claim→code→test→runtime evidence; measure coverage and broken links.
ideas.success_metric: At least 9/10 claims have complete, fresh, reproducible evidence chains.
ideas.kill_criteria: Stop or redesign if evidence references cannot be resolved deterministically or source ownership is ambiguous.

ideas.title: Counterfactual Micro-Patch Laboratory
ideas.hypothesis: For selected defects or performance gaps, a minimal patch can be compared against an unchanged baseline in isolated reproducible runs.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Choose one deterministic module; run baseline and candidate against identical fixtures and seeds.
ideas.success_metric: A reproducible difference report separates improvement, regression, and inconclusive outcomes.
ideas.kill_criteria: Reject claims if baseline drift, nondeterminism, or environment mismatch prevents fair comparison.

ideas.title: Temporal Architecture Drift Radar
ideas.hypothesis: Versioned repository snapshots can reveal gradual drift in interfaces, dependency contracts, ownership, and test coverage before breakage.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Compare 3 known commits and validate detected changes against manually labelled changes.
ideas.success_metric: Precision and recall are measured on labelled drift events; false positives are reported.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not operationalize if detection cannot distinguish expected evolution from risky drift.

ideas.title: Dependency End-of-Life Early Warning
ideas.hypothesis: Mapping direct and transitive dependencies to support windows, licenses, and replacement paths reduces urgent migrations.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Audit one manifest and lockfile with a dated, source-cited lifecycle snapshot.
ideas.success_metric: Every production-critical dependency has a version, owner, support status, license status, and migration trigger.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not rank a dependency as vulnerable or obsolete without current authoritative evidence.

ideas.title: Capability and Boundary Genome
ideas.hypothesis: Explicit machine-readable contracts for each subsystem make unintended authority expansion and hidden coupling detectable.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Model one subsystem's inputs, outputs, capabilities, state writes, and forbidden actions; compare manifest to observed tests.
ideas.success_metric: Boundary violations have executable negative tests and a digest-bound contract.
ideas.kill_criteria: Hold if the boundary contract is ambiguous or cannot be independently checked.

ideas.title: Mutation Budget and Blast-Radius Estimator
ideas.hypothesis: Estimating changed files, dependency fan-out, criticality, and rollback cost before patching improves selection of safe micro-changes.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Estimate blast radius for 20 historical changes and compare with observed affected tests/files.
ideas.success_metric: Calibration error is reported; high-uncertainty estimates trigger human review rather than false precision.
ideas.kill_criteria: Reject estimates that cannot explain contributing signals or are systematically miscalibrated.

ideas.title: Failure-Lineage and Negative-Knowledge Ledger
ideas.hypothesis: Preserving failed experiments, rejected hypotheses, and their context prevents repeated waste and supports better future decisions.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Record 10 failed/rejected candidates with reason, environment, revision, and re-test trigger.
ideas.success_metric: Future proposals can detect a prior equivalent failure and explain whether conditions have changed.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not reuse a failure as a permanent veto if environment, assumptions, or implementation materially changed.

ideas.title: Independent Verifier Rotation
ideas.hypothesis: Separating patch authorship from verification and periodically rotating verification methods reduces correlated blind spots.
ideas.minimal_experiment: For 5 changes, compare author tests with a separate verifier's adversarial cases and replay.
ideas.success_metric: Verifier independence and incremental defect discovery are explicitly measured.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not label verification independent if it shares the same assumptions, fixtures, or code path without justification.

ideas.title: Stale-Evidence Expiry and Revocation
ideas.hypothesis: Evidence with explicit freshness rules, source revisions, and revocation status prevents old green checks from authorizing new code.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Define freshness windows for CI, dependency audit, runtime telemetry, and approval records; test stale/revoked cases.
ideas.success_metric: Stale or revoked required evidence fails closed with an explicit blocker.
ideas.kill_criteria: Hold rollout until evidence types and freshness policies have owners and deterministic semantics.

ideas.title: Reproducibility Capsule
ideas.hypothesis: Pinning commit, dependencies, runtime, seeds, commands, fixtures, and environment metadata makes historical experiments replayable.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Capture a reproducibility capsule for one passing and one failing experiment; replay both on a clean runner.
ideas.success_metric: Replay outcome and declared tolerance are recorded, including reasons for non-bitwise equivalence.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not claim reproducibility if key environment variables or dependency inputs remain unknown.

ideas.title: Pareto Frontier for Engineering Choices
ideas.hypothesis: Keeping non-dominated candidates across impact, risk, cost, reversibility, and evidence quality avoids collapsing complex decisions into one opaque score.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Compare weighted ranking with Pareto filtering on 10 labelled candidate decisions.
ideas.success_metric: Trade-offs are visible and dominated options are explainable; no universal winner is fabricated.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not use the frontier without normalized dimensions and domain-appropriate thresholds.

ideas.title: Architecture Option Value Ledger
ideas.hypothesis: Small interface and modularity investments can be evaluated by the future options they preserve, not only immediate throughput.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Choose one coupling point and compare current change cost with a reversible seam or adapter design.
ideas.success_metric: Option value is expressed through measurable scenario costs, migration paths, and uncertainty ranges.
ideas.kill_criteria: Reject speculative value claims without explicit scenarios and assumptions.

ideas.title: Synthetic Fault and Chaos Cases
ideas.hypothesis: Targeted fault injection into isolated test harnesses exposes brittle assumptions in retries, partial failure, stale data, and rollback.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Inject timeout, missing artifact, corrupt report, duplicate event, and interrupted write into a local harness.
ideas.success_metric: Every injected fault yields a documented safe state, useful evidence, and bounded recovery behavior.
ideas.kill_criteria: Never inject faults into production or external systems without separate explicit authorization.

ideas.title: Human Attention and Decision Queue
ideas.hypothesis: Grouping candidates by shared root cause and showing evidence gaps reduces reviewer fatigue and improves decision quality.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Present 20 proposals in raw order versus evidence-gap clusters to reviewers; compare review time and missed blockers.
ideas.success_metric: Review time and blocker detection are measured without reducing safety or traceability.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not optimize for approval speed if rejection quality or blocker detection worsens.

ideas.title: Semantic Duplicate and Conflict Detection
ideas.hypothesis: Comparing proposals against registry items, prior decisions, APIs, and failed experiments reduces duplicate work and conflicting designs.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Label 100 pairs as duplicate, related, conflicting, or unrelated and measure precision/recall of candidate matching.
ideas.success_metric: Thresholds and false-positive/negative costs are documented; ambiguous matches go to review.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not auto-reject proposals on embedding or lexical similarity alone.

ideas.title: Runtime Reality Diff Adapter
ideas.hypothesis: Comparing declared capabilities with authorized runtime observations can detect gaps between design claims and actual behavior.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Use a local mock runtime with a declared expected state and controlled observations; verify mismatches are surfaced without invented data.
ideas.success_metric: Every runtime claim carries source, timestamp, environment, and observer provenance; unavailable telemetry remains UNKNOWN.
ideas.kill_criteria: Never infer a service is live from a manifest or CI success alone.

ideas.title: Five-Year Scenario and Trigger Register
ideas.hypothesis: Scenario-based triggers are more defensible than point predictions for technology, dependency, scale, and governance changes.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Create three scenarios for one critical dependency or interface with observable triggers, leading indicators, and response playbooks.
ideas.success_metric: Each scenario has explicit assumptions, trigger signals, review cadence, and an owner; forecasts are revised when evidence changes.
ideas.kill_criteria: Do not present scenarios as certain predictions or leave triggers without measurable definitions.

ideas.title: Budgeted Autonomous Research Loop
ideas.hypothesis: A bounded loop that searches, proposes, simulates, verifies, and checkpoints can improve exploration while keeping costs and authority finite.
ideas.minimal_experiment: Run a local dry-run loop with fixed candidate, recursion, time, and retry budgets; require checkpoint on exhaustion.
ideas.success_metric: Every run terminates within budget, records costs and lineage, and never promotes without independent review.
ideas.kill_criteria: Stop on budget ambiguity, missing verifier, non-replayable evidence, or any attempt to expand its own authority.
